description: DUT ignores an unimplemented TCP option in a SYN and completes the handshake (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 p85)
approach:
[Objective]
Forward compat: an unknown option kind must be skipped (using its declared length), not cause connection refusal. RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 enables future extensions.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with an unknown option kind (kind=99, length=4, value=0).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK + DUT reaches ESTABLISHED.

[Pass condition]
DUT completes handshake.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT ignored unknown option and handshook — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
